Vendored MathJax runtime
========================

This directory contains the browser assets required by MathJax 3.2.2:

- tex-mml-chtml.js for TeX/MathML input and CommonHTML output;
- the AMS TeX extension used by numbered equations; and
- the CommonHTML WOFF fonts loaded by the renderer.

The files were copied without modification from the official mathjax@3.2.2
npm package: https://www.npmjs.com/package/mathjax/v/3.2.2

Package integrity:
